name: CLIENT_ID
label: Application (client) ID
help: Agents reach SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook and Outlook Calendar as the user who connected, through this app registration's delegated permissions, so they can never open more than that user can.
setupSteps: In the Microsoft Entra admin center, open App registrations and select New registration.

Choose Accounts in this organizational directory only (the package README describes a multitenant setup, which needs settings this wizard doesn't collect), add a Web redirect URI with the value below, and register.

Under API permissions, add Microsoft Graph delegated permissions: openid, profile, email, offline_access and User.Read; for SharePoint, Sites.ReadWrite.All and Files.ReadWrite.All; for Outlook, Mail.ReadWrite, Mail.ReadWrite.Shared, Mail.Send, Mail.Send.Shared, MailboxSettings.ReadWrite, People.Read and User.ReadBasic.All; for Calendar, Calendars.ReadWrite, Calendars.ReadWrite.Shared, MailboxSettings.Read, People.Read and User.ReadBasic.All. A wizard install asks users for this full set, so granting less makes connecting fail; a deployment that wants read-only access or only selected sites sets the environment variables the package README describes.
Select Grant admin consent, so users aren't asked to approve each permission themselves.
Under Certificates & secrets, create a client secret, and note when it expires: connections stop refreshing once it does.
Copy the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID from the Overview page, and the secret's Value (not its ID), here.

name: MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID
label: Directory (tenant) ID
help: Only accounts in this Microsoft 365 organization can connect. The tenant ID is on the app registration's Overview page.
